notes.title: RELEASE ON OCTOBER 20
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001183/923c631298f5e7da314b418c09b4be6661322564.png[/img]

We're happy to announce that our project is coming out on Steam on October 20. The road to release on Steam has been a long and exciting journey, and we're happy to have made it with players. See you at Shemergard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001183/1aaf7d6e9ca699e291741dcd0e64dd73112d2a17.jpg[/img]

P.S. We have prepared a little surprise for Telegram users - a sticker-pack with characters from the game. Get it by following this link - https://t.me/addstickers/WithGoodIntentions
